thesis_title: Computer Vision Approach to Identify Parked Vehicles Based on Smartphone Camera Data

plan.status: (updated 2026-10-11, session 6) Fresh start on the real map (Town10HD_Opt artefacts deleted 2026-10-11, tag town10-stand-in-final). Phase 0 and Phase 1 complete (poses P1 to P5, routes A, B, C, scripted stop, cutoff 0.15, four study areas). Phase 3: 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3 done: the 53-run matrix is captured (3.3 GB in carla/data/kt_*), every run's labels were checked numerically and by overlay, three stalled route B runs were diagnosed (angled bay R25-1249, now skipped) and recaptured, smoke runs deleted. Ahead of plan: fine-tuning recipe, train_matrix.sh (S1), bootstrap confidence intervals. GDPR: the DPO's second reply (2026-10-12) set the conditions (event-based storage only, one defined zone, DSI at vehicle and zone, project description, one VVT per processing, supervisor confirms measures, OE needed); package v0.2 rewritten to meet them, in docs/data_protection/, to be sent by the user. Android app builds and passes 27 shared tests; not run on a device. Nothing trained or measured on the new map yet. 3.4 done: datasets/kt_v1 exported (14 910 frames, 132 668 boxes, verify passes). Next: Phase 4 (4.1 to 4.3, 5.1) and S1 training. Technical work ends 2026-11-15 (moved from Oct 31 on 2026-10-20).

phases.title: Phase 6: Experiments on kt_v1 and the training matrix

items.text: 6.1 EXP-A zero-shot detection sweep: {v8n, 11n, 26n, 26s} × {640, 960, 1280} on all five test runs.
6.2 EXP-B zero-shot parked rule, t_parked sweep per scenario, with the warm-up ceiling line.
6.3 Training matrix S1: four architectures × three seeds on kt_v1 train, GPU, 960 px.
6.4 EXP-C / EXP-D fine-tuned detection and pipeline versus the *best* zero-shot configuration.
6.5 EXP-E traffic 10/30/60; EXP-F weather, viewpoint and occupancy fill, plus the red-light-stop false-positive check. Failure attribution with analyse_failures.py.
6.6 Pick the deployment candidate by D-J (provisionally on synthetic test; final after EXP-H).

timeline.text: S1 training matrix started (smoke run passed: 1.8 min per epoch, mAP50-95 0.70 after one epoch). Phase 4 item 4.1 done: the pipeline refuses a run captured on a different map than the region file. Item 5.1 done: a Python parity test replays the 790-step decision-rule vectors the smartphone app also tests against (all pass), the evaluation self-check passes, and one complete result row with confidence intervals was produced on a kt_v1 test run. Item 4.3 done: a stationary-window detector finds the frames in which the windshield camera stood still from the images alone; on the scripted-stop run it recovers the 10 s red-light stop with frame precision 0.93 and recall 1.00, and finds nothing in runs without a stop. Item 4.2 done: the pipeline can now run on polygons drawn in the image (the path real smartphone footage will use, identical to the app); on a synthetic run it agrees with the reference world-space path on 97.9 % of parked decisions. Phases 4 and 5 are complete.

Technical cut-off moved to 2026-11-15; four technical weeks from today: S1 training (Oct 20 to 23), pipeline and harness items 4.1 to 5.1 (by Oct 25), synthetic experiments (by Nov 1), real recording if released (target Nov 6), S2/S3 and results freeze (Nov 15).
Progress dashboard created: experiments/publish_progress.py collects plan, dataset, matrix, training, results, models, figures and commits into the public site.

Answered the DPO's second reply with data-protection package v0.2: German project description, privacy-notice texts, two VVT entries, one 110 m recording zone on Goethestraße (B 16a) from no. 12 a (Sparkasse) to the end of no. 14, one recording day, raw-footage window 72 h. Public privacy notice page published (DE/EN). Submission deadline set to 2027-01-15.

Full 53-run capture matrix on KIVI_Twin captured and checked (frame counts, label statistics, overlays); three stalled windshield runs diagnosed (angled bay R25-1249) and recaptured; dataset kt_v1 exported and verified (no split leakage, road 2 test-only). Plan v2 written; Town10 pilot artefacts archived under tag town10-stand-in-final.
40 parking spots populated on KIVI_Twin from the OpenDRIVE parking spaces and the measured Sparkasse lot.
CARLA server, geometry and evaluation self-checks, and GPU PyTorch confirmed on the rebuilt machine.
Machine reinstalled (Ubuntu 26.04); KIVI_Twin CARLA 0.9.14 build installed; Python environments rebuilt.

app.origin: COCO-pretrained yolov8n exported to ONNX, opset 17, 640 px, zero-shot - placeholder until the KIVI_Twin fine-tuned model is selected
app.input: images 1x3x640x640 float32 BCHW, RGB normalised to [0, 1], letterboxed with (114, 114, 114) padding
app.output: output0 1x84x8400 = [cx, cy, w, h, 80 COCO class scores], no NMS
app.class_map: COCO (car = 2, bus = 5, truck = 7); the fine-tuned export will use 0 = car, 1 = truck, 2 = bus
app.runtime: ONNX Runtime Android 1.31.0, CPU execution provider
app.exported_outputs_verified_against_pytorc: no (placeholder model; verification required before any mobile number is reported, see README "Model files")
